notes: Microsoft Foundry Global Standard preview. Native Chat JSON and SSE use /mai/v1/chat/completions on the services.ai.azure.com endpoint; targetModel is the deployment name.

Use max_completion_tokens. Set reasoning_display to encrypted to receive opaque reasoning.encrypted_content, then return the complete assistant message unchanged on subsequent turns. Never decode, log or display the encrypted state.
Streaming terminates with [DONE]. An output safety block can emit a terminal SafetyBlockedError event before [DONE]. Tool calls can use finish_reason stop; inspect the message tool_calls field.
Exact model-specific pricing has not been verified as of 2026-09-11. pricingCatalogEntry remains null.
